dedupe_keys.name: assessing fuel structure in old growth eastern hemlock dominated stands of nova scotia canada

description: Assessing fuel structure in old-growth eastern hemlock dominated stands of Nova Scotia, Canada is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. We present a dataset of measurements and observations of combustible live and dead vegetation (also known as fuel structure) in 15 old-growth stands dominated by eastern hemlock from southern to central Nova Scotia, Canada. The 15 stands were selected along a gradient of a recorded hemlock woolly adelgid infestation in Nova Scotia. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Natural Resources Canada | Ressources naturelles Canada. Its tags are eastern hemlock, fire behaviour, fuel structure, insects, old-growth forests. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-02-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
